messages.content: 你能幫我為我和朋友共10位計劃在華盛頓州西雅圖的一天嗎？我們都是美食愛好者，想要嘗試一些海鮮和意大利菜作為午餐。晚上，我們有興趣參加一場音樂會或體育賽事。你能幫我找到適合我們的餐廳和活動嗎？

function.name: restaurant_find_group
function.description: Find restaurants suitable for groups based on specified criteria such as location and cuisine. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city and state, e.g. Seattle, WA

cuisine.description: Preferred cuisine at the restaurant. Default is all if not specified.

group_size.description: Size of the group that the restaurant should accommodate.

function.name: events_find_event
function.description: Find events suitable for groups based on specified criteria such as location and event type. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city and state, e.g. Seattle, WA

event_type.description: Type of event. Default is all if not specified.

group_size.description: Size of the group that the event should accommodate.

message.reasoning:
The user wants to plan a day in Seattle for a group of 10. They want lunch with seafood or Italian. Then an evening event: concert or sports. We need to find restaurants suitable for groups based on location, cuisine, group size. Also find events suitable for groups based on location, event type, group size.

We have two functions: restaurant_find_group and events_find_event. We'll call them accordingly.

We need to provide results from both calls. The user didn't specify a particular cuisine preference between seafood and Italian; they said they'd like to try some seafood and Italian. So we might search for restaurants that serve either seafood or Italian. But the function signature expects cuisine?: "Seafood" | "Italian" | "Chinese"[]. Wait the type says cuisine?: "Seafood" | "Italian" | "Chinese"[]. That seems odd: Chinese is an array? Probably a mistake. But we can pass cuisine: ["Seafood", "Italian"]? Or maybe we need to pass one value. The spec says default is all if not specified. So we could just not specify cuisine to get all. But we want to filter. Maybe we can pass cuisine: "Seafood" or "Italian". But we can't pass multiple. The spec may allow array but it's typed incorrectly. Let's assume we can pass array. We'll pass cuisine: ["Seafood", "Italian"]. For group_size: 10. Location: "Seattle, WA".

Similarly for events: location: "Seattle, WA", event_type: ["Concert", "Sports"], group_size: 10.

We'll call both functions. Then we will return the results.
